name: Snapshot
source:
Magic and science. Past and future. But what of the present?
The heiress of an ancient magical family uses a special camera to uncover the past — both of history, and of herself.

(From Itch.io and Steam)

Developed and released as part of [URL=https://itch.io/jam/magical-girl-game-jam-3]Magical Girl Game Jam 3[/URL].
Based on a [URL=https://www.wattpad.com/918617744-snapshot-the-modern-prodigal-daughter]short story of the same name[/URL].
translation:
魔法与科学。过去和未来。但现在呢？
一个古老魔法家族的女继承人使用特殊的相机来揭开过去——包括历史和她自己的过去。

（来自Itch.io和Steam）作为 [URL=https://itch.io/jam/magical-girl-game-jam-3]Magical Girl Game Jam 3[/URL] 的一部分开发和发布。
基于 [URL=https://www.wattpad.com/918617744-snapshot-the-modern-prodigal-daughter]同名短篇小说[/URL]。
